explanation: Count set bits at each of 32 positions across all values and reduce each count modulo three. Triplicated values contribute zero modulo three, leaving the signed bit pattern of the unique value. The file also includes a two-mask alternative.
timeComplexity: O(32n), or O(n) for fixed-width integers.
